info.title: API.SH: Trendyol
info.description: The Trendyol API from API.SH: public Trendyol data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Trendyol product by link: id, name, brand, SKU, colour, category, price and currency, availability, number of other sellers, rating, rating and review counts, the attribute table, highlights, description, breadcrumbs and images. Also: brand id, favourites count, original price and discount, `lowest_price_days` (the price is the lowest of that many days), maximum installments, warranty (type, period), shipping (free flag, standard rate, fast-delivery hours, handling and transit days, cut-off time), the buy-box seller's score, city and logo (`seller_info`), every other seller's offer with price, score and delivery (`offers`), promotions, variants with stock and price, the category tree and links to similar products.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trendyol-product

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of one trendyol.com product, 20 per page: rating, text, likes, date, verified purchase, the seller it was bought from, size and review photos (reviewer names are masked by the site). Also returns the average rating, rating and review counts, the 1-5 star breakdown, review topics with their positive and negative counts, and the site's AI review summary. Filter by star rating, words, topic, seller and reviews with photos. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trendyol-reviews

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Product id (the number after -p- in a product link, or `id` from /trendyol/v1/search). Either product_id or url is required.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only reviews about this topic (a `topics[].name` value from a previous response, e.g. Paketleme).

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Only reviews of purchases from this seller (`reviews[].seller_id`).

parameters.name: with_media
parameters.description: true for reviews with photos or videos only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on Trendyol (Turkey) for keywords, with the site's sort and a price range. Each product: id, name, brand, category, price, original and old price, discount, currency, rating and rating count, seller id, free-shipping flag, promotions, badges, link, images and `raw`. `total` is the site's count (capped at 100,000). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Filter by brand, category, seller, free shipping, minimum rating, size and colour; each product also carries its `brand_id`. `facets=true` adds the site's filter groups with value ids and counts (brands, sizes, colours, ratings, categories and more) to find ids for these filters.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trendyol-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (optional when category_id, brand_id or seller_id is given).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, best_seller, most_favourite, most_rated, newest.

parameters.name: brand_id
parameters.description: Brand ids, comma separated (a product's `brand_id`, or `facets` Marka values).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Category ids, comma separated (from `facets` Kategori values or a trendyol.com -x-c<id> link).

parameters.name: free_shipping
parameters.description: true: only products with free shipping.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: A size value id from `facets` (Beden), e.g. group-m.

parameters.name: color_id
parameters.description: A colour value id from `facets` (Renk), e.g. 2 for beige.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: true: add `facets`, the filter groups with value ids and counts. Costs an extra lookup.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
